g.text: CHIEF / DIRECTOR NURSING
policy, directorates, national office
DEPUTY DIRECTOR (DDNS+)
regional/district leadership
PRINCIPAL NURSING OFFICER
in-charge, specialists, tutors
SENIOR NURSING OFFICER
shift leads, preceptors
STAFF NURSE / MIDWIFE
bedside foundation — all start here
EDUCATION CLIMB: diploma/RGN → BSc top-up (2–3 yrs) → MPH/MSc/MPhil → PhD/
postdoc; specialities via post-basic certificates (critical care, perioperative, ophthalmic,
ENT, mental health, paediatrics, oncology, nephrology, emergency) + midwifery (post-basic
or direct). Study leave: serve → apply → bond (rules vary — read yours); scholarships:
Ghana scholarships, Commonwealth, DAAD, facility sponsorships — apply EARLY + widely.
PROMOTION FUEL: appraisals (M01: no surprises — feed back year-round), CPD log
(PRO-I M7: courses + reflections + QI/audit evidence), interviews (STAR from portfolio),
exams where required, clean disciplinary record (PRO-I M3 ladder avoided), years served.
Plan in 5-year blocks: \"by 2030: BSc + critical-care cert + SNO + 2 QI publications\" —
reviewed yearly with a mentor (M02). Lateral moves teach: CHPS → ICU → classroom →
policy — breadth before height builds the directors of tomorrow.
Exam line: \"climb deliberately — qualifications open doors, portfolios walk through them.\"
